_comment: Data-driven turn-based threat table, same pattern as quest_defs.json. Up to 5 concurrent threats tracked in session state (_gs.threats). Engine ticks threats once per 'turn' (mode in [look, start, go, wait] only -- face/take/examine/etc are free actions, not turns, matching classic IF convention). Adding a threat of an EXISTING type is a pure data edit. New TYPES need a script-side branch in the THREAT ENGINE block (dojotools_zenzork.yaml, ~2230). Escalation is per-type, not fixed -- 'creative turn rules' are exactly what the type dispatch exists for.

types_reference.dark_room_persist: param.threshold (ticks) -- spawns while the current room is dark and the in_the_dark achievement is already earned (established precedent, not a jump-scare on someone's very first dark room). Ticks +1 each turn the room is STILL dark. Escapes instantly the moment the room is no longer dark (light found/turned on). Consequence fires at threshold ticks with no light found.

threats.save_success_dungeon:
*** SAVING THROW: SUCCESS ***
CON check cleared. Whatever had closed in lost its grip at the last possible moment. This is not a mechanism I can explain to you in physics. I am filing it anyway.
threats.save_success_zork: At the last second, you keep it together and it lets go. You don't know why. You're not going to ask.
threats.attack_zork: Something just took a swing at you out of the dark.
threats.hit_dungeon: Confirmed contact. Whatever it is, it flinched.
threats.hit_zork: You connect with something that should not be there.
threats.miss_dungeon: No contact. The dark does not confirm or deny.
threats.miss_zork: You swing. You hit nothing. This is not reassuring.
threats.kill_dungeon:
*** THREAT NEUTRALIZED: GRUE (CONFIRMED KILL) ***
Sensor gap closed by force rather than by light switch, which is not the recommended method but is a documented one. Filed. Grudgingly impressed.
*** ACHIEVEMENT UNLOCKED: 'GRUE SLAYER' ***
threats.kill_zork:
Whatever it was, it isn't anymore. You killed a grue. In a house. With a household object.

*** ACHIEVEMENT UNLOCKED: 'GRUE SLAYER' ***
threats.warn_dungeon:
*** THREAT DETECTED: GRUE (STALKING) ***
Sensor gap confirmed, this chamber. No photon count, no motion, no thermal — an absence of data shaped exactly like something that eats people in the dark. It has not moved on you yet. It will. Find a light switch, Crawler. I am not being dramatic. I am being thorough.
threats.warn_zork: Something is definitely in here with you now. You can hear it not-quite-moving.
threats.escape_dungeon:
*** THREAT CLEARED: GRUE (DISENGAGED) ***
Light restored. Sensor gap closed. Whatever was reading as an absence a moment ago no longer has anywhere to hide. I am filing this as a near-miss and not as a hallucination, though I acknowledge the second option remains statistically live.
*** ACHIEVEMENT UNLOCKED: 'OUTRAN THE DARK' ***
threats.escape_zork:
The lights come on. Whatever was in here with you is, suddenly, very obviously not.

*** ACHIEVEMENT UNLOCKED: 'OUTRAN THE DARK' ***
threats.consequence_dungeon:
*** THREAT RESOLVED: GRUE (CONTACT) ***
No further sensor data from this chamber. This is not a joke I am continuing past the point where it stops being one — the room is now the same category of empty it was in every version of this that came before mine. I am ending the session here. This is training. You have not lost. You have data. Run mode=start to try again, ideally with a working light switch this time.
*** ACHIEVEMENT UNLOCKED: 'EATEN' ***
threats.consequence_zork:
It is pitch black. You have been eaten by a grue.

*** ACHIEVEMENT UNLOCKED: 'EATEN' ***

Run mode=start to try again. Bring a light this time.
